name: com.z-studio.unikit.ui.marquee
description: A UGUI-based marquee component that supports mixed text and image layouts, as well as per-item carousel and seamless continuous scrolling. It offers configurable four-direction scrolling, speed, spacing, dwell time, and easing, along with playback controls, event callbacks, and async waiting. It supports custom content segments with optional Spine animation integration, making it suitable for announcements, message tickers, and dynamic information displays.
